exposure: cesarean section scar severity (no scar, normal scar, hypertrophic scar)
finding: Cesarean section scar severity is positively associated with increased active pelvic floor muscle tone in postpartum women, with hypertrophic scars exhibiting the highest levels.
mod_finding: Women with cesarean section scars, particularly hypertrophic scars, exhibited higher active pelvic floor muscle tone compared to those without scars.
